# Nodsend

Nodsend is a Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) approval API for AI agents.

## What it does
When an AI agent is about to take a consequential action, it sends a POST request to api.nodsend.com/v1/approvals. Nodsend delivers the request to a human via email, waits for their approval or rejection, and notifies the agent via webhook.

## API Base URL
https://api.nodsend.com

## Authentication
Bearer token: Authorization: Bearer appr_live_xxxx

## Core endpoint
POST /v1/approvals
Content-Type: application/json
Idempotency-Key: your-stable-operation-id
{
  "action": "string",
  "summary": "string (max 500 chars)",
  "details": {},
  "channel": "email",
  "recipient": "human@example.com",
  "expires_in": "1h",
  "webhook_id": "registered-webhook-id",
  "external_id": "your-workflow-id",
  "metadata": {}
}

Create and cancel requests require an Idempotency-Key. Webhook destinations
must be registered in the Nodsend console before their ID is used on an
approval. Verify Nodsend-Webhook-Signature over
<event_id>.<timestamp>.<raw_request_body> before resuming a workflow.

## Documentation
https://nodsend.com/docs

## Discovery
- API catalog: https://nodsend.com/.well-known/api-catalog
- OpenAPI: https://api.nodsend.com/openapi.yaml
- Agent authentication and human provisioning: https://nodsend.com/auth.md
- Public pages support `Accept: text/markdown` content negotiation.

## Content use
Search and agent input are permitted. General-purpose model training is not permitted.
